Also applied the established BLDALPHA/BG2X-share-a-base idiom (wrote the post-frame-49 BLDALPHA store as M2C_FIELD((void*)0x04000028, u16*, 42) instead of a fresh 0x04000052 cast) and an explicit (u32) cast on the `frame <= 14` guard to match the reference's unsigned bhi.n branch -- both confirmed correct against the .s file even though the second one's aggregate score did not move (its effect was absorbed by unrelated downstream drift). Remaining 96 wrong_instructions/223 differing_halfwords are entirely register-letter and instruction-scheduling divergence, concentrated in one root cause already documented as non-source-controllable on this owner's own family siblings (games/gs1/recon/en/main/080d59b0.json, 080dc1ec.json): this compiler's allocator chooses to hoist the loop-invariant `(u8*)work + offset` pointer (work always in r9, offset a plain hoisted local) into a single dedicated register across the whole kind-47 decoration loop, whereas the reference's compiled output recomputes it from r9+r8 via two instructions on every one of the 4 iterations instead -- register-pressure-driven, since the reference needs that same spare low register for the fp-relative screen-y read inside the loop body. Every other diff in the file (bl target trampoline register r4-vs-r5 selection, mov-before/after-call ordering for the fp screen pointer, which literal-pool slot backs a given absolute MMIO/heap-cache address) is a direct downstream consequence of this one hoist decision shifting register availability, not an independent defect. Tried and reverted: inlining the kind-47 draw's x/y expressions directly into the call argument list (worse, 104 wrong_instructions); hoisting `(u8*)work+offset` into its own named pointer local before the loop (no change -- the compiler already does this hoist on its own regardless of source phrasing, confirming the hoist is compiler-driven, not source-shape-driven); pre-computing `&Data_03001e50[47]` as a separate pointer local dereferenced each iteration (no change, same codegen as plain `Data_03001e50[47]` -- the address is a link-time constant either way).

Semantic summary: a battle-presentation sub-effect that allocates a work block, a 16KB canvas, and a small trail-sprite buffer; sets BG2 affine scale and blend alpha; loads a palette selected by a 4-way switch on the target object's kind field; seeds a fixed-address 128-entry particle array (side effect, unused by this function) and a 64-entry in-work 'star' record array; registers a 48x48 rectangle-blit callback (kind 46); then runs 56 frames. Each frame re-projects a single tracked point to screen space, shakes BG2's horizontal offset and (after frame 49) fades BLDALPHA, cues a sound/vibration effect once at frame 26, draws a large kind-46 sprite during frames 28-48, bursts four small kind-47 decorations during frames 0-14 from ROM-table-driven offsets, and advances/draws up to 64 sparkle-trail squares whose radius and screen position come from a sine/cosine sweep of each record's stored angle.

Field offsets 0x77b4/0x77b8 on the work block are new to this owner (no precedent in the sibling dossiers); left as raw M2C_FIELD offsets rather than guessing names, matching this family's established practice for byte-offset accesses with no evidence-backed structure yet.
